                         Project Development Objectives
                         Project Development Objective (from Project Appraisal Document)

                         The objective of the Project is to assist the Borrower in: (i) strengthening its capacity in managing public policies and the public service; (ii) improving the efficiency of
                         social protection spending through an integrated monitoring and targeting system; and (iii) improving the income and employability of the vulnerable population through
                         temporary employment and training programs.
                         Has the Project Development Objective been changed since Board Approval of the Project?

                            Yes           No

                         Implementation Status Overview


                                                                                                                                                                                                              Page 1 of 7
                             The World Bank                                                                                                                                            Report No: ISR14440



                         The Project has been effective since September 2013 and four disbursements have been requested, amounting to approximately $ 1.6 million (16% of the loan), including the
                         resources from the Project Preparation Advance (PPA) that started in 2012. The launching of the Project and the initial steps of this first lending operation in Antigua received close
                         monitoring and implementation support from the Bank team. Four missions have taken place since the launch of the Project and video and audio conferences are held regularly.
                         Moreover, high ranking officials from the Labour Department and the Ministry of Social Affairs have participated in the WBG Core Courses in Labor and Safety Nets. The
Public Disclosure Copy




                         implementation of all four components was relatively slow in the beginning, and most efforts are being concentrated on recruitment of key consultants and staff, as well as
                         refurbishing offices to receive future beneficiaries of the programs supported within this Project.

                         Based on the information made available at the time of the last supervision mission held on March 2014, in the public sector modernization area, some important advances have
                         taken place since the last ISR. Under component 1, a diagnostic study was produced that formulated recommendations for strengthening the institutional capacity of the Cabinet
                         Secretariat in coordinating policy issues and analyzing documents for Cabinet approval. A draft plan for the implementation of the recommendations has been prepared, and
                         Government has identified officials to serve as policy analysts, who have received induction training.

                         The Bank team communicated to the Government that Juan Martin Moreno will replace Gaston Blanco as task team leader of the social protection side of the Project, effective
                         September 2014.
